descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At SOFMEDICA , we are a purpose-driven healthcare technology group dedicated to making cutting-edge medical innovations accessible to patients across New Europe.
Our people drive our impact. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare — and making a real difference in patients' lives every day.
We're growing our team and are looking for a passionate IT Administrator providing first-level technical support to all employees, ensuring the smooth operation of the company's IT systems and infrastructure. This role is crucial in maintaining productivity and efficiency by resolving user-facing issues and empowering employees to effectively and securely utilize the available technology.
Provide prompt and efficient IT support to employees, via phone, email, and in-person, addressing a wide range of technical issues 
Manage the new Team Members' onboarding, offboarding activities such as setting up user accounts, access privileges, and IT equipment 
Maintain IT inventory and manage equipment lifecycle and optimize purchases and budget 
Document and Maintain IT knowledge base such as processes, user guides 
Conduct effective training sessions and provide guidance to employees, on day-to-day digital security, the use of software, applications, and IT systems Monitor and maintain the company's IT inventory, including hardware and software assets 
Collaborate with the IT team and Vendors to identify and resolve any incidents and system-wide problems, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations 
Stay up to date with the latest technological trends and best practices to recommend improvements and enhancements for IT and Digital work 
Escalate complex technical issues to the senior IT team as needed 
Periodical reports on infrastructure parameters and actions 
 Requirements
2 years of experience in a similar position and one year in an administrative position 
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues 
Excellent knowledge of computers, business software applications 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team 
Self-taught, ability to learn, adapt and stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends 
Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users 
Ability to effectively communicate with the team 
Self-driven, calm, person of character, kind, positive 
Thorough, analytical skills, shows initiative 
 Nice to Have
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field 
previous experience in a similar position 
Knowledge and practical experience with ITIL framework 
Certifications and Qualifications that prove your understanding of the necessary concepts for the Responsibilities section 
 Benefits
Mission-driven, innovative, and ethical culture
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge medical technologies that save lives
Collaborative, international team
Learning & career path
